profile_note: Documented approximation of the modern amplifier (dossier Sec. 33). Not a measured one-to-one model: no specimen was measured.
dossier: Fender 57 Custom Deluxe -- Public-source Engineering Dossier, Edition 1, 5 November 2026

calibration.fixed_delay_samples: derived: oversampler group delay, reported to the host

rated_output_power.note: into 8 ohm, <5% THD, 1 kHz; marketed as 12 W. Used as a calibration anchor and acceptance check.

input1_impedance.note: reproduced by the jack network (checked in validation)

input2_impedance.note: reproduced by the jack network (checked in validation)

tube_complement.note: manual prints 6V6GC, product page 6V6; installed marking must be recorded per specimen

speaker_part.value: Eminence Special Design alnico 12in, Fender PN 7708599000

netlist.note: topology and component values are the historical 5E3 baseline; modern service schematic not authenticated (dossier Sec. 04)

ot_turns_ratio_full_primary.note: FTDO-59 8k:8 class; identity with modern OEM part unproven

pt_hv_half_winding_rms.note: supply transformer parameters UNKNOWN; value CALIBRATED (cd57_validate --calibrate-pt) so the interpolated 5% THD power into 8 ohm equals the documented 12.5 W for the JJ-fitted tube laws; the anchor weakly constrains this value (see the sensitivity table in the validation report)

tube_interelectrode_capacitances.note: datasheet-class values that are NOT contained in the dossier text (external, unverified offline)

triode_grid_conduction_law.value: I=k*(s*softplus((vgk-vc)/s))^1.5 (k=0.35 mA/V^1.5, vc=-0.5 V, s=0.15 V)
triode_grid_conduction_law.note: no grid-current data for the 12AY7/12AX7 in the dossier; onset and slope need measurements (dossier Sec. 16)

volume_pot_taper.note: manufacturer advertises revised tapers; numerical law not located

volume_pot_taper_provisional.note: selectable in the plugin (audio-15 / audio-10 / linear); not claimed as the modern Fender taper

pot_endpoint_contact_resistance.note: documented small contact resistance instead of dividing by zero (dossier Sec. 08)

speaker_Re.note: exact-target value UNKNOWN (dossier manifest example lists null)

speaker_Bl_of_x_and_Kms_of_x.note: large-signal speaker nonlinearity not modelled (no data)

tube_12AY7_koren.note: fitted to 1313 pixel-digitised points of the JJ transfer + plate sheet; operating region (Vp 50-350 V, Vg -6..0 V): rms 0.063 mA, relative 5.1 % (tail-dominated); whole held-out curves and cross-panel prediction in data/tubes/fitted_models.json; local mu/rp/gm at the RCA point differ from the RCA numbers the dossier quotes (a JJ-vs-RCA data difference, not forced); no specimen curve-traced; grid conduction ASSUMED

tube_12AX7_koren.note: fitted to 910 pixel-digitised points of the JJ transfer + plate sheet; operating region (Vp 50-350 V, Vg -6..0 V): rms 0.050 mA, relative 4.8 % (tail-dominated); whole held-out curves and cross-panel prediction in data/tubes/fitted_models.json; local mu/rp/gm at the RCA point differ from the RCA numbers the dossier quotes (a JJ-vs-RCA data difference, not forced); no specimen curve-traced; grid conduction ASSUMED

tube_6V6_pentode.note: cathode-current law fitted to the digitised JJ 6V6S sheet (assumed triode-connected, Ia = plate+screen): amp region rms 2.67 mA / 7.1 % relative, positive-grid region 19.5 %; screen partition fs0 and Early voltage va come from an EXTERNAL RCA 6V6GT rating point that is NOT in the dossier; knee shape vk, q ASSUMED

tube_6V6_grid_conduction.note: plateau digitised from the JJ 6V6S dashed Ig curves (Ug=+5 V: 7.9 mA, +20 V: 12.2 mA at Ua 150-350 V); onset (vc, sg) ASSUMED; Ig dependence on plate voltage below 100 V not modelled

rectifier_5Y3_forward.note: per-anode forward law fitted to the digitised JJ 5Y3S right panel (dashed branch is the manufacturer's extrapolation); in-circuit regulation check against the left panel: tools/validate_supply.cpp

calibration_volts_per_full_scale_input_s.note: user-adjustable 'Input Cal'; NOT a Fender specification

calibration_output_samples_per_volt.note: 0 dBFS = 28.28 V peak at the speaker terminals (rated 12.5 W sine, 14.14 V peak = -6 dBFS)
